title: INVOL Tool � REACC (MUC1A06AC / YMQAC05IN) � Promise Stays at 14-Day Mark � Eligible
description:
Customer's flight was disrupted and the system auto-rebooked via REACC (React/Auto-Accommodation). Identifier: MUC1A06AC or YMQAC05IN in PNR history. REACC is classified as INVOL � the promise does NOT update and stays at the 14-day mark. Validates REACC classification as INVOL and that promise remains unchanged.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Laurent Tremblay); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; REACC auto-rebook at D-2: new arrival 14:30; Actual arrival: 14:30; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
